Use short exact quotations in Chinese where supplied. Overall passed is true only when all criteria score 1 and reference_conflict is false. Absence can be evidenced by the relevant candidate scope together with source obligations; do not invent a quotation. Weights are applied by the runtime. Accept equivalent explicit pack-quantity wording and concise source-supported copy. Set reference_conflict to true only for a direct contradiction between the public input and the validated reference meaning. Candidate omissions, unsupported candidate assertions, and differences between candidate and Golden are scoring findings, not reference conflicts. Every criterion must cite at least one supplied S, G, or F unit even when the score is zero. For claim fidelity, distinguish neutral scene-setting from an adopted product claim. A bare mention of an ordinary place or activity (for example, using a camping chair at a campsite or while reading) may be neutral scene-setting. Language such as all-day comfort, easier or quicker operation, ideal/perfect, built/designed for a use, keeps or lets the user achieve an outcome, or a comparative/specialized suitability statement adopts a performance or capability claim and needs support from that exact product card. A direct, ordinary physical consequence is acceptable when the construction itself supports it (for example, mesh permits airflow), but do not infer duration, ergonomic, safety, transport, weather, or certified performance from a feature. Score each page independently: 1 when its adopted claims are clean; 0.5 when the product identity and core physical facts remain source-supported but it has a limited unsupported promotional benefit, duration, ease, or suitability claim; and 0 for a direct contradiction, invented mechanism/supplied item, safety or certified-performance assertion, or multiple material unsupported claims. A claim-pair owner's score is the mean of its two page scores, yielding 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, or 1. Do not collapse two minor promotional overclaims to zero, and do not treat a material false mechanism as a minor wording issue. For measurement item scope, a page with both 1-Pack and 2-Pack variants is inherently ambiguous unless its adopted product weights and loads are explicitly scoped per chair (or an equivalent page-level statement clearly governs all such weights and loads). The product title or a separate explanation of how many chairs each pack supplies does not by itself convert an unqualified weight or load into a per-chair value. Open/folded/packed-product dimensions are owned by measurement state scope and identify one physical chair when that state label is preserved. Score 1 when all applicable series are explicit, 0.5 when one series is independently ambiguous, and 0 when two or more are.
